Body





Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)

Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) is a flagship Government of India health assurance scheme aimed at providing access to quality and affordable secondary and tertiary healthcare services to economically vulnerable sections of the population. The scheme was launched on 23 September 2018 by the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, and is among the world’s largest publicly funded health assurance programmes.




Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana (MMSY)

The Government of Punjab has launched the Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana (MMSY),
a historic step toward Universal Health Coverage for the state of Punjab. The scheme aims
to provide cashless treatment up to ₹10 lakh per family per year to all 3 crore residents
of Punjab. This move significantly expands health protection from the earlier ₹5 lakh
coverage which was limited to specific categories.



MMSY includes all bona fide residents of Punjab, including government employees
and pensioners, with no income cap or exclusion criteria. The scheme ensures access to
secondary, and tertiary care in both public and private empaneled hospitals of Punjab.
Enrollment is simple and accessible through CSCs using Aadhaar and Voter ID.
Beneficiaries will receive MMSY health cards. The scheme also adopts the latest Health
Benefit Package (HBP 2.2), ensuring more comprehensive coverage and higher treatment
rates. More than 2000 treatment packages are selected for treatment under the scheme.
